newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator rises 9 cents to 659c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator rises 9 cents to 659c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose another nine cents to 659 cents a kg clean on Wednesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, taking the week's gain to 19 cents, Wool International said.
Most merino fleece strengthened with 19/22 microns 1.5 percent dearer, 20m three percent dearer, 21m two percent dearer, 23/25m 0.5 percent dearer, 24m slightly dearer and 26m unchanged.
In merino skirtings, 19/22m were slightly dearer and 20/21m up to two percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/29/30/31m were one percent dearer and 28m 0.5 percent dearer.
In cardings, merino lambs were unchanged,crossbred combing lambs one percent dearer, locks unchanged, stains fully firm and crutchings slightly dearer (up to 5.0 percent dearer in Sydney).
WI said Japanese interests including China were principal buyers with support from Taiwan and Western Europe.
Of the 27,431 bales offered, 4.6 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney and Fremantle with about 61,200 bales to be offered.
